name: Setup
blurb: Connect NovaGuard to a server and manage its saved configuration.

name: System
blurb: Public health, release and help commands.

name: Server diagnostics
blurb: Detailed checks and changelog previews for server managers.

name: Developer
blurb: GitHub intelligence delivered into your server.

name: Utility
blurb: Everyday tools for members and staff.

name: Fun
blurb: Quick games and icebreakers.

name: Moderation
blurb: Slash-native moderation with warnings kept on record.

name: Levels
blurb: Automatic XP for chatting, progress cards and leaderboards.

name: Level administration
blurb: Preview a historical XP rebuild before any data changes.

name: Welcome
blurb: Join and leave embeds plus auto-role for newcomers.

name: Logs
blurb: Deleted and edited messages, joins, leaves, bans and mod actions.

name: Roles
blurb: Persistent button panels where members pick their own roles.

name: Giveaways
blurb: Button entry, a live counter and automatic winner selection.

name: Tickets
blurb: A private support thread with the configured staff role.

name: AutoMod
blurb: Invite blocking, anti-spam and a managed blocked-word list.

name: Voice reports
blurb: Configure, inspect and retry completed voice-session reports.

name: Voice hours
blurb: Monthly voice activity totals and the server leaderboard.

name: Economy
blurb: Wallets, rewards, games, collectibles and the server shop.

name: Music
blurb: Playback, queue controls, audio effects and connection diagnostics.
note: Shuffle, loop, seek and filter are available when the Lavalink backend is enabled.

name: AI
blurb: Claude answers directly in Discord when AI is enabled by the host.

name: Owner operations
blurb: Sensitive host-wide actions protected by owner checks and, where required, the admin key.
